about: Diagnostics.BusState with the values of types/0x0002-diagnostics.md §2.4: ACTIVE 0, PASSIVE 1, BUS_OFF 2. The port's own WARNING (TEC/REC above 96) is not a value of the attribute — the specification covers it with ErrorThreshold — and goes out as ACTIVE. Until 2026-10-03 the node sent the port's 0…3 as they were, so PASSIVE arrived as 2, which the specification calls BUS_OFF (zadania/zrobione/CR-05.md). Every change of the attribute is also reported (zadania/zrobione/TASK-01.md); WARNING is not one.
